title: Drift mining sources
description: Repositories the weekly drift job reads (tools/bin/mine-trunk.ts). Checked by validate-skills.

id.description: Key in docs/.mining-state.json and in a rule's `upstream` list. Never renamed.

extractor.description: `shopware-trunk`: agent skill bullets, guideline headings, review guide IDs, PR template lines and PHPStan or Danger rule classes. `markdown`: bullets and headings of every Markdown file.

paths.description: Watched paths; a commit counts when it touches one of them.

skills.description: Our skills that learn from a path of the source. The mapper's fallback for a change no rule cites.

path.description: A path prefix in the source repository.
